Test Description: Validate GPIO register block by checking default reset values and verifying masked write/read behavior across a predefined register address list for GPIO_8..GPIO_27. Applies per-register write/read masks, writes data patterns, and confirms readback against expected values derived from masks and defaults.
Meta Test Description: test_case(): calls chk_rst_val(); then chk_rd_wr(); finishes with pass/fail based on counters. chk_rst_val(): for i in [0..CNT-1], addr=addr_array[i]; skip if skip_rst_array[i]==1 or read_mask_array[i]==0; data_rd=read_reg(addr); data=(data_rd & 0xfffffffe); compare to default_value_array[i]. chk_rd_wr(): for data patterns {0xffffffff,0xaaaaaaaa,0x55555555,0xf5f5f5f5,0xA5A5A5A5,0xffff0000}, write masked values to each addr (if writable and not skipped); then read masked values and compare to expected value computed from masks and defaults.
Remarks: When reading default values, DIN may become 1 automatically if not forced; forcing zero to DIN may set level select high, causing mismatch.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Prepare addr_array, default_value_array, read_mask_array, write_mask_array, skip arrays. 2) Default check: for each address, if readable and not skipped, read and compare masked default. 3) Write/Read: for each of six patterns, write masked data to writable addresses, then read/verify masked values against expected using masks and defaults. 4) Aggregate failures and set overall PASS/FAIL.
Meta Test Steps / Procedure: 1) test_case(): chk_rst_val(); chk_rd_wr(); finish(1) if (def_fail_cnt>0 || wr_fail_cnt>0) else finish(0). 2) chk_rst_val(): iterate i; apply read mask and compare to defaults. 3) chk_rd_wr(): iterate patterns; for each i, write masked data when allowed; then data_rd=(read_reg(addr)&read_mask); wr_n=(write_mask^0xffffffff); exp_val=((data_wr & read_mask & write_mask) | (wr_n & read_mask & default)); compare. 4) soft_reset_chk() present but disabled (#ifdef 0).
